title: Something is still using a disabled account

support.label: retries arrive at a regular interval
one host carries at least 80% of failures

next_steps: Confirm with the identity team whether {account} was disabled on purpose, for example a leaver, a retirement or a security hold. Do not ask for it to be re-enabled until you know why.
If it was retired on purpose, remove {account} from whatever is still using it on {top_host}.
If it should be active, raise a request with the identity team through the standard path.
